rationale: Current UX is temporary; a real UI comes later. If the UX is workable, no fix needed.

rationale: Same as #68: temporary UX, workable, cosmetic label only.

title: Reloading or directly navigating to the home route ('/') logs an already-authenticated user out, while other routes preserve the session
action: close with note: duplicate of #31
rationale: Same behavior as older open #31 (found while finishing the pass). User lives only in memory (useCurrentUser context); no route survives a reload. /translate just lacks an auth guard. Session persistence is not built yet.

title: English-Hebrew-English phrase is misclassified as kind:'word' and returns an empty sense list with no explanation
action: mark as known-issue and leave open
rationale: Model returned no content; server's empty-result path defaults kind to 'word'. Unrealistic input, generic 'not found' message.

title: English-dominant sentence containing one Hebrew word is detected and labelled as a Hebrew-to-English translation
action: mark as known-issue and leave open
rationale: Output is correct (fully English) and the input is a realistic learner use; only the direction label could describe it better.

title: Results screen shows the numeric score but labels it as if it were a step/progress count, so a learner cannot tell it is their score
action: mark as known-issue and leave open
rationale: Score data is correct; only the label is ambiguous with the progress counter.

title: Senses whose part of speech is 'determiner' render with no part-of-speech label at all, while other senses of the same word show theirs normally
action: to_be_fixed
rationale: Not a duplicate: same fingerprint as #58/#47/#32/#30 but unrelated behavior. Mobile POS label map lacks 'determiner' and 'numeral' from PartOfSpeechSchema. Client and shared contract disagree; any future UI must handle every schema value, so fix ASAP.

title: Editing the dictionary input leaves the previous word's full result card on screen, with nothing marking it as outdated
action: mark as known-issue and leave open
rationale: Standard search-screen behavior; results persist until resubmit. Workable.

title: Dictionary input has no visible character limit until you are already well over it, and the field never stops accepting extra characters
action: mark as known-issue and leave open
rationale: Limit is enforced and the hint states it; only the timing of the hint is the complaint.

title: Hebrew idiom translation contains a stray space breaking the prefixed word ('ב יובל' instead of 'ביובל')
action: leave open
rationale: Model output, persisted in DB. Not a duplicate. Translation quality will be improved in the future.

action: mark as known-issue and leave open
rationale: Validation works and explains itself; only inconsistent with login's disabled state.

title: The dictionary never shows which translation direction it will use until after you submit, and there is no way to set it in advance
action: mark as known-issue and leave open
rationale: Auto-detection is by design and cannot be wrong; a live indicator would be polish.

title: Looking up a phrase that mixes an English word followed by a Hebrew word can make the server fail with a 502, while the same idea in pure English, pure Hebrew, or Hebrew-then-English order succeeds
action: to_be_fixed
rationale: Reproducible 5xx is a real_bug regardless of input. Model answer rejected by parse/correction guards (TranslationUnreadable -> 502); should degrade like the empty-answer path.

title: 'Switch user' returns to the login screen with the current username still filled in, so it doesn't actually help switch accounts
action: mark as known-issue and leave open
rationale: No server session exists; remembered username is a feature. Switching works with one extra step.

title: Sentence-length lookups silently apply spelling correction with no banner, unlike word/phrase lookups which explicitly disclose it
action: mark as known-issue and leave open
rationale: Documented scope (phase 13 spec: corrections are words/phrases only); translation is correct.
